meta.roomStandard: Private en-suite bathroom + Queen-size or King-size bed verified per row (Twin/Full entry rooms excluded)
meta.pricedStayWindow: Monday 15 Feb 2027 → Monday 22 Feb 2027 (7 nights). Preferred short trip is 15–18 Feb 2027 (3 nights); broader allowed range is 15 Feb – 23 Mar 2027 (1–4 weeks).
meta.taxLawNote: Per NYC Administrative Code §11-2502 & NYS sales/MCTD tax (legistar.council.nyc.gov), NYC hotel stays incur 14.75% combined occupancy + sales tax plus $3.50–$4.00+/night flat unit/Javits fees (and mandatory property resort fees where applicable). Every row below shows BOTH Pre-Tax 7-Night Total and All-In 7-Night Total so candidates can be compared apples-to-apples.
meta.michelinProximityFinding: 67 of 69 NYC Michelin-starred restaurants are inside the 5 boroughs (2 — Blue Hill at Stone Barns in Tarrytown and La Bastide in North Salem — are in Westchester and unreachable within 1 hr by MTA subway/bus). Across 25 Google Maps transit legs captured 2026-11-25 between 5 Manhattan hotels and all 5 NYC Michelin clusters (Midtown 51st, Flatiron/NoMad, Tribeca/SoHo, FiDi, and Williamsburg Brooklyn), EVERY leg measured 3 to 37 minutes. Therefore all central Manhattan hotels reach all 67 five-borough starred restaurants (and ~300 NYC Bib/Selected venues) in ≤60 minutes; ranking ties are broken by average cluster transit time, cancellable all-in 7-night price, and verified bed/bath quality.
